decisions.decision: SYNC remains hidden across ordinary per-panel refreshes; bindings are disabled until all three frames flush. Mid-reveal failure performs a best-effort SYNC fallback and rejects the commit.
decisions.rationale: Implements R-2: visible pixels may briefly mix only while no key is actionable.

decisions.decision: Settings persist only schema-versioned ThemeId and LedGrammarId in Preferences namespace keypad; invalid/missing values fall back without write-back.
decisions.rationale: Fallback is not user confirmation; firmware never persists host data or bindings.

decisions.rationale: R-1 permits ambient motion only as complete frames inside a measured budget and below semantic states.
